Bookings and online product orders use t.af: Besprekings en aanlyn produkbestellings gebruik die finansiegrootboek wanneer deur die platform vereffen. Loop-in kleinhandelbestellings verskyn volgens betaaldatum selfs sonder grootboekrye. Legacy POS-rye wys bruto as netto.
Bookings and online product orders use t.zu: Ukubhuka nama-oda emikhiqizo ye-inthanethi asebenzisa incwadi yezimali lapho kuxazululwa ipulatifomu. Ama-oda okuthengisa okungena ngaphandle avele ngosuku lokukhokhelwa ngisho ngaphandle kwemigqa yencwadi. Imigqa ye-POS yedumela ibonisa inani eliphelele njengenethi.

Bookings and online product orders use t.st: Litheho le liodara tsa lihlahisoa tsa inthaneteng li sebelisa bukana ea lichelete ha li lefisoa ke sethala. Liodara tsa thekiso tse kena ka kotloloho li bonahala ka letsatsi la ho lefshoa le ha ho se na mela ea bukana. Mela ea POS ea khale e bontša palo e felletseng e le net.

Uma isikhathi singasekho, lelo vakasha lingase liweqe kuze ubuyekeze nesitolo.

Payment is charged to your Apple ID. The.af: Betaling word op jou Apple ID gehef. Die intekening hernu outomaties tensy jy ten minste 24 uur voor die einde van die huidige periode kanselleer. Bestuur, kanselleer of aanvaar 'n prysverandering enige tyd in Apple ID → Subscriptions. Enige bekendstellingsaanbod op hierdie plan word outomaties toegepas wanneer jy inteken. Verlos 'n promosie- of win-back-aanbodkode met Redeem App Store offer code. Enige ongebruikte gedeelte van 'n gratis proef, indien aangeboden, verval wanneer jy koop.
Payment is charged to your Apple ID. The.zu: Inkokhelo ishelwe ku-Apple ID yakho. Ukubhalisa kuvuselelwa ngokuzenzakalelayo ngaphandle kokuba ukhansele okungenani amahora angu-24 ngaphambi kokuphela kwesikhathi samanje. Ungayilawula, uyikhansela, noma wamukela ushintsho lwentengo noma nini ngaphansi kwe-Apple ID. Isiphakamiso sokuqala siyasebenza lapho ubhalisa. Kukhona nezindlela zokusebenzisa ikhodi yokukhuthaza. Ingxenye engasetshenziswanga yesivivinyo samahhala iyalahleka lapho uthenga.

Payment is charged to your Apple ID. The.st: Tefo e lefisoa Apple ID ea hau. Peeletso e nchafatsa ka boiketsetso ntle le haeba u hlakola bonyane lihora tse 24 pele nako ea hajoale e qetella. Laola, hlakola, kapa amohela phetoho ea theko nako efe kapa efe Apple ID → Subscriptions. Tlhahiso efe kapa efe ea ho qala moralo ona e sebedisoa ha u ingolisa. Sebedisa khoutu ea papatso kapa ea ho busetsa ka Redeem App Store offer code. Karolo e sa sebedisoang ea teko ea mahala, haeba e fanoe, e lahleha ha u reka.

Payment is charged to your Apple ID. The.ts: Xihakelo xi hakeriwa eka Apple ID ya wena. Xivumelwano xi pfuxeta hi ku tisungulela handle ka loko u khansela u nga ri hafu tiawara ta 24 u sa athu nkarhi wa sweswi wu hele. Lawula, khansela, kumbe pfumela ku cinca ka nxavo nkarhi wun'wana eka Apple ID → Subscriptions. Nyiko yin'wana ya u thoma eka xileriso lexi yi tirhisiwa hi ku tisungulela loko u bhalisa. Hlawula khoutu ya papatso kumbe yo vuyisa hi Redeem App Store offer code. Xiphemu lexi nga tirhisiwanga xa ku ringeta mahala, loko xi nyikiwile, xi lahlekeriwa loko u xava.
